detect_azure_endpoint: detect whether an Azure AI Foundry endpoint uses OpenAI chat_completions or Anthropic messages API transport
probe_azure_models: probe an Azure OpenAI endpoint to retrieve the list of available models via the GET /models endpoint
lookup_model_context_length: look up the context length for a given model name by calling the Azure endpoint and model metadata resolver
create_detection_result: create a DetectionResult dataclass to hold the detected API mode, available models, hostname, and reason for auto-detection
check_anthropic_path: check if a URL path indicates an Anthropic-style Azure Foundry endpoint by looking for /anthropic in the path
